description: A stereo oscillator built from four sine partials whose phases are pushed around by one of their own outputs, so the waveform reshapes itself as the feedback is opened up

params.text: Sets the pitch, -4V to 4V against 261.63Hz at 0V
Spreads the four phases around the cycle, 0 to 5, from evenly apart through unison, two-way and three-way groupings and back
Rotates all four phases together, -360 to 360 degrees
Pushes the left and right outputs apart in phase, -360 to 360 degrees
Sets how much of the feedback partial is fed into the phase spread, -1 to 1
Multiplies the rate of the feedback partial against the pitch, 1 to 10 times, with a curve that lingers on the whole-number ratios
Attenuverts the node CV before it is added to the node knob
Attenuverts the rotate CV before it is added to the rotate knob
Attenuverts the spread CV before it is added to the spread knob
Attenuverts the feedback CV before it is added to the feedback knob
Attenuverts the FM input before it is added to the pitch
Rotates the phase at which the feedback partial is taken, -360 to 360 degrees
Attenuverts the feedback position CV before it is added to that knob
Attenuverts the multiply CV before it is added to the multiply knob
Snaps all four phases back to the start of their cycles while it is held

inputs.text: A rise snaps all four phases back to the start of their cycles
Sets the pitch as a volt per octave, added to the pitch knob; the number of channels here is what makes the module polyphonic
Moves the phase spread, added to the node knob through its attenuverter and wrapped round its range
Rotates all four phases, added to the rotate knob through its attenuverter at 36 degrees per volt
Pushes the two outputs apart in phase, added to the spread knob through its attenuverter at 36 degrees per volt
Changes the feedback amount, scaled by a tenth and added to the feedback knob through its attenuverter, the total clamped to -1 to 1
Modulates the pitch through its attenuverter, a fifth of a volt per octave after the attenuverter, added before the pitch is converted to a frequency
Moves where the feedback partial is tapped, added to the position knob through its attenuverter at 36 degrees per volt
Changes the feedback partial's rate ratio, added to the multiply knob through its attenuverter and clamped to 10 times

outputs.text: The left side of the stereo pair, one of the partials as a sine clamped to -5 to 5V
The right side of the stereo pair, a second partial as a sine clamped to -5 to 5V

notes: polyphony comes from the V/OCT jack alone: the outputs take their channel count from it, and each other CV jack spreads its own channels across the voices or feeds them all from its first
two parameters are declared without a widget, so the panel has no rate attenuverter and no preset control even though the tooltips exist in the code
